note: Proposed replacements for the unmeasured G5 (Brown belt) and E5 (Black belt) skill checks in data/progress/belt-gates.json. minWpm is correct words per minute, self-reported. Targets come from the rank's wpmTarget in data/curriculum/belts.json, which is Aleph's own proposal, not sourced. A timed read never earns or holds back a rank: ranks are earned by finishing lessons.

G5.label: Timed read-aloud of one text, 3 reads, about 70 words a minute (self-reported)

E5.label: Timed read-aloud of one longer text, 3 reads, about 80 words a minute (self-reported)
